response.overview: It tells the story of Adellea Sofea, a lecturer with a Master's degree who is very selective in choosing a husband. Sofea, who has many followers on her social media, frequently posts motivational words and videos guiding women on how to choose a good partner. Secretly, Sofea has been friends with Alif Firdhaus (Fir), whom she met on social media two years ago. Sofea is attracted to Fir because he frequently uploads videos of himself playing guitar and often dedicates special videos to Sofea. Through only the words that Firdhaus shares on social media, Sofea concludes that Firdhaus comes from a happy family. Indirectly, Sofea believes that Firdhaus is also the perfect man to be her husband. Without Sofea's knowledge, Firdhaus is hiding a secret. An introduction to Dr. Fauziah (Fazlina Ahmad Daud) brings Sofea to Firdhaus's family home, where she is shocked by Firdhaus's sudden return.
response.title: Adellea Sofea
